plan.cache_only_note: --offline is enforced in ferclib/http.py. Replay preflight hash-verifies every unique object declared by source_cache/index.json before opening the output database; an uncaptured request remains an explicit offline source limitation and never opens a socket.
plan.date_policy: The source question is pinned to 2026-09-07, the date represented by the original universe cache. Later, narrowly recovered official-FERC objects retain their own retrieval timestamps. A reporting-year-end eLibrary response may contain occurrences posted after the as-of boundary; those raw bytes remain captured but such occurrences are excluded before persistence with an append-only warning. Generated coverage metadata is pinned separately by --built-at. Retrieval time, regulatory effective date, reporting period and build time are never substituted for one another.

known_external_limitations.policy: The failed all-ID request and nine non-200 one-ID observations remain preserved as retrieval observations, not source-unavailability claims. Offline replay uses only the verified successful cache object.
known_external_limitations.status: captured from the official public endpoint by a one-ID request that returned the complete ten-member accession ZIP; exact ZIP/member identities verified and imported

known_external_limitations.policy: The release gate reads actual page pixels through local macOS Vision, retains raw OCR/confidence and bounded corrections, and requires exact semantic agreement with an independent source-hash-bound review. It never uses network access or forwards credentials.
known_external_limitations.status: implemented and mandatory on the declared macOS build host; not portable unchanged to non-macOS hosts

plan.purpose: Deterministic, cache-only reconstruction of the scoped operating-assets database and one coherently published consumer generation. Every step declares inputs, dependencies and verifiable outputs. Resume revalidates those identities instead of trusting a prior success flag.

sqlite_query.sql: SELECT entity_key,filing_id,metric_id,review_status,rationale,evidence_hash FROM reviewed_source_annotations ORDER BY entity_key,filing_id,metric_id

steps.why: Load and verify annotations before any adapter canonicalises source values.

sqlite_query.sql: SELECT source_regime,COUNT(*) AS observations,COUNT(DISTINCT entity_key) AS entities FROM observations WHERE reporting_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 OR reporting_year IS NULL GROUP BY source_regime ORDER BY source_regime

steps.why: Build every current operating regime from captured inputs; any failed unit has an honest non-zero exit.

sqlite_query.sql: SELECT entity_key,reporting_year,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM observations WHERE entity_key IN ('C000020','C000654') AND reporting_year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2023 GROUP BY entity_key,reporting_year ORDER BY entity_key,reporting_year

steps.why: Preserve the declared older history in addition to, not instead of, the current window.

sqlite_query.sql: SELECT metric_id,COUNT(*) AS observations,MIN(period_start) AS first_interval,MAX(period_end) AS last_interval,COUNT(DISTINCT entity_key) AS entity_keys FROM observations WHERE entity_key='FERC-OIL-INDEX' AND source_regime='FERC Oil Pipeline Index' GROUP BY metric_id ORDER BY metric_id

steps.why: Persist all 31 official notice occurrences and the 30 factor / 30 explicitly published change observations exactly once under the global regulatory-instrument identity; 52 observations validate and eight remain review-gated for four source-anomaly notices.

sqlite_query.sql: SELECT source_doc,source_row,disposition,metric_id,template FROM requirements_crosswalk ORDER BY source_doc,source_row

steps.why: Generate every crosswalk in memory, validate, publish atomically, then replace the database table.

sqlite_query.sql: SELECT e.requirement,e.slot_state,e.source_health,COUNT(*) AS slots,SUM(m.populated) AS populated,SUM(m.source_matched) AS source_matched,SUM(m.validated) AS validated,SUM(m.in_review) AS in_review FROM coverage_expected e JOIN coverage_measured m USING(slot_id) GROUP BY e.requirement,e.slot_state,e.source_health ORDER BY e.requirement,e.slot_state,e.source_health

steps.why: Build expectations from eligibility, pinned form/taxonomy applicability and due rules independently of successful ingestion, then measure with strict unit/period/scope/version/lineage gates.
